title: The 11 official refusal reasons (Visa Code Annex VI) and their legal basis (Art. 32)

facts.statement: Refusal reason 1: a false, counterfeit or forged travel document.
facts.quote: a false/counterfeit/forged travel document was presented

facts.statement: Refusal reason 2: purpose and conditions of the stay not justified.
facts.quote: justification for the purpose and conditions of the intended stay was not provided

facts.statement: Refusal reason 3: no proof of enough money for the stay and the return.
facts.quote: you have not provided proof of sufficient means of subsistence, for the duration of the intended stay or for the return to the country of origin or residence

facts.statement: Refusal reason 4: already used 90 days in the current 180-day period.
facts.quote: has already stayed for 90 days during the current 180-day period on the territory of the Member States

facts.statement: Refusal reason 5: an entry-ban alert in the Schengen Information System.
facts.quote: an alert has been issued in the Schengen Information System (SIS) for the purpose of refusing entry

facts.statement: Refusal reason 6: considered a threat to public policy, security, health or international relations.
facts.quote: one or more Member State(s) consider you to be a threat to public policy, internal security, public health

facts.statement: Refusal reason 7: no adequate and valid travel medical insurance.
facts.quote: proof of holding an adequate and valid travel medical insurance was not provided

facts.statement: Refusal reason 8: the information about purpose and conditions was not reliable.
facts.quote: the information submitted regarding the justification for the purpose and conditions of the intended stay was not reliable

facts.statement: Refusal reason 9: your intention to leave before the visa expires could not be established.
facts.quote: your intention to leave the territory of the Member States before the expiry of the visa could not be ascertained

facts.statement: Refusal reason 10: applying at the border without proof you could not apply in advance.
facts.quote: sufficient proof that you have not been in a position to apply for a visa in advance, justifying application for a visa at the border, was not provided

facts.statement: Reason 11: the visa holder asked for the visa to be revoked.
facts.quote: revocation of the visa was requested by the visa holder
